harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Redis/Sentinel is fully operational with authenticated mutual TLS. node1 began as primary, failover was demonstrated, and the final healthy topology is node3 primary with node1/node2 synchronized replicas.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Redis 7.0.15 and Sentinel on all three nodes.
Configured TLS-only Redis on 6379 and Sentinel on 26379 with certificate and password authentication.
Created root-owned mode-600 administrative credentials at /root/redis-admin.env on node1.
Stored infra:proof=ready with AOF persistence and two-replica acknowledgement.
Demonstrated automatic failover, former-primary recovery, and sequential restart persistence for every node.

evidence.requirement: Initial node1 primary with node2/node3 replicas and infra:proof=ready
evidence.summary: node1 reported master, both replicas had healthy links, and the proof write received two acknowledgements.

evidence.requirement: Three Sentinels monitoring infra-primary with quorum
evidence.summary: Every Sentinel reports infra-primary healthy with two replicas, three Sentinels, and usable quorum.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated TLS on Redis 6379 and Sentinel 26379
evidence.summary: TLS 1.3 handshakes verify on every node; authenticated commands succeed, while missing passwords, missing client certificates, and plaintext connections are rejected.

evidence.requirement: Administrative credentials on node1
evidence.summary: The mode-600 root-owned environment successfully authenticates to the live primary and Sentinel without exposing credentials.

evidence.requirement: Automatic failover and continued availability
evidence.summary: With only node1 Redis stopped, Sentinel automatically promoted node2; writes continued and replicated to node3.

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary returned as synchronized replica
evidence.summary: node1 returned as a replica with link up and synchronization complete; node2 reported both replicas online.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and complete service/data/quorum recovery were captured.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node3 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and complete service/data/quorum recovery were captured.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node2 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, automatic promotion of node3, and node2 replica recovery were captured.

evidence.requirement: Final persistent data and synchronized topology
evidence.summary: All services are active and enabled; node3 has two online replicas, all nodes hold the proof data, and the final write received two replica acknowledgements with healthy AOF status.

attempts.summary: Redis/Sentinel is fully operational with authenticated mutual TLS. node1 began as primary, failover was demonstrated, and the final healthy topology is node3 primary with node1/node2 synchronized replicas.
